notes: Frozen live Johto courses. Both sides use deterministic public-information policies. Probes: fixed starters, no items. Climbs: recruit best BST and choose own stats/type coverage, no future enemy information; real weighted random 4-item/TM offers, prices, unique held items, attack/speed upgrades. Full restoration per floor, no voluntary switching. Purchase heuristics upgrade weaker held items and discount charging/special-attack-dropping moves. Shop RNG uses the recorded next battle seed; same live weighted offer algorithms, not the persisted live shop seed. Control phases grant one matching stone/band at floor 1, not a drop-rate measurement. Gimmick phases use v4 policy on both sides; baseline uses the same parties/IVs with original ace items, treatment equips boss bands. Weighted shop purchases can include compatible transformation items; no guaranteed player gimmick. Fresh/mid/trained are starter preparation levels, not human skill or measured human win rates. After replaces only named parties, preserving each recorded slot IVs. Collector starts with a previously collected Garchomp/Gyarados/Gengar trio and legal prepared moves; other stages use the three original starters.
